title: fm-reconcile.sh: reconciling after a crash
acceptance: replaying events.jsonl rebuilds the whole state with no snapshot
walks state/worktrees and gh pr list to find orphans
a worker whose pid is gone is marked worker_crashed and redispatched
reconciling is idempotent: two runs leave the same state
a merged pull request whose event carried no task is repaired from the branch name
it prints what it would change and changes nothing with --dry-run
